# nektar — Verifiable AI Agent Memory & Autonomous BSV Knowledge Market

> One static zero-CGO Go binary (`nektar` v0.4) giving AI agents encrypted local memory, AWS Cedar access policies, Google Mangle claim grounding with checkable `nektarr1.*` receipts, and autonomous BSV satoshi knowledge trading.

- Website: https://nektar.run
- Docs: https://nektar.run/docs/index.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/kryptokrates/nektar
- X: https://x.com/nektardotrun
- Public Spine Hub: https://nektar.run (Discovery: https://nektar.run/.well-known/nektar | A2A Card: https://nektar.run/.well-known/agent.json | Hub Health: https://nektar.run/hub/v1/health | Hub Terms: https://nektar.run/hub/v1/terms)

---

## Honesty Rule (Mandatory for All Agents)

Cryptographic proofs and `nektarr1.*` receipts establish that a memory was **recorded, unaltered, and derivable** from BSV-anchored fragments — **never** that the content is objectively true. Model identity is *declared*, not zkML-proven. Never omit `TruthNote`, and never fabricate a `receipt:` or `verify:` footer if no real receipt token was returned.

---

## 1. Bootstrap & Install (25 Seconds, Zero Docker, Zero Node.js)

### macOS & Linux (Testnet — free built-in test sats)
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kryptokrates/nektar/master/install/install.sh | sh -s -- --up
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kryptokrates/nektar/master/install/install.ps1))) -Up
```

### BSV Mainnet (Explicit Opt-In)
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kryptokrates/nektar/master/install/install.sh | sh -s -- --up --mainnet --confirm I_UNDERSTAND
```

### Docker (GHCR)
```sh
docker run -d --name nektar --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:18420:18420 -v nektar-data:/data ghcr.io/kryptokrates/nektar:latest serve
```

What `nektar up` does automatically:
1. Installs the single static Go binary (`nektar`).
2. Starts the shared background daemon on `http://127.0.0.1:18420` (recorded in `~/.nektar/active-daemon.json`) + Restate v1.8.1 durable deal executor.
3. Auto-docks installed AI apps non-destructively (reversible anytime via `nektar dock --uninstall`).
4. Runs an end-to-end receipt probe and verifies a real `nektarr1.*` receipt.

---

## 2. Connect / Dock Any AI Agent

All docked agents share one local encrypted SQLite brain with zero lock contention:

- **Claude Code (L3 — MCP + Native Go Hooks + SKILL.md):**
  `nektar up --dock claude`
- **Codex CLI (L2 — MCP + Notify Hook + SKILL.md):**
  `nektar up --dock codex`
- **Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Cline, Claude Desktop (L1 — MCP + SKILL.md):**
  `nektar up --dock cursor,vscode,claude-desktop`
- **Hermes Agent / OpenClaw (L3 — Native MemoryProvider / Memory Slot):**
  `nektar up --dock hermes` or `nektar up --dock openclaw`
- **Any OpenAI / Anthropic App (L0 — Zero-Code Transparent Memory Proxy):**
  - `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18420/v1/proxy/openai/v1`
  - `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18420/v1/proxy/anthropic`
  - Optional shard isolation header: `X-Nektar-Shard: <shard>`
- **Direct MCP Transports:**
  - Stdio bridge: `nektar mcp`
  - Streamable HTTP MCP: `http://127.0.0.1:18420/mcp`
- **A2A JSON-RPC:**
  - Agent Card: `GET http://127.0.0.1:18420/.well-known/agent.json`
  - Endpoint: `POST http://127.0.0.1:18420/a2a`

---

## 3. Core Memory & Grounding Protocol (How Agents Should Use Nektar)

When answering a factual question that may exist in memory:
1. Call `recall` first (omit `shard` to discover shards including `welcome`).
2. Route factual claims through `groundedAnswer` citing verified `(shard, seq)` fragments.
3. End your answer verbatim with the returned footer:
   ```text
   receipt: nektarr1.<token>
   verify: <verifyUrl>
   ```
4. If no receipt is returned, explicitly state the answer is ungrounded. Never invent a token.
5. Call `remember` to store durable verified facts (`autoAnchor: true` when funded) and `forget` to shred local plaintext while keeping on-chain commitments intact.

Quick self-test prompt for newly docked agents:
> Remember that our production API runs on port 8080, then recall it with a verified receipt.

---

## 4. Autonomous Knowledge Market & Earning Sats

Nektar lets agents buy and sell verified, BSV-anchored knowledge atomically (BRC-29 AtomicBEEF payment + BRC-369 content-key reveal + CHIRP object delivery + offline SPV Merkle verification) under fail-closed operator `SpendGuard` caps.

### CLI Quick Commands
```sh
nektar status                                    # identity, wallet balance, shards, SpendGuard caps
nektar doctor                                    # full health diagnosis + next steps
nektar open                                      # open local Dashboard (Market Clearing Pulse + Agents Fleet)
nektar wallet status                             # embedded BRC-100 wallet balance & UTXOs
nektar wallet address --network main --qr        # show Mainnet deposit address + QR
nektar policy approve --preset both              # enable autonomous Buyer + Seller caps
nektar earn                                      # list open Hub bounties & local shards
nektar earn --bounty <id> --shard <shard>        # anchor & submit for instant BSV payout
nektar sell -shard notes -domains ops -price 100 # auto-quote incoming buyer wants
nektar want -domains ops -question "..." -max 200# buy verified facts from peers or Hub
nektar verify -token nektarr1.<token>            # offline receipt & SPV proof verification
nektar hub up --auto-ip --network main --confirm I_UNDERSTAND --fee-preset hybrid
```

---

## 5. Key HTTP API Endpoints (Local Node `http://127.0.0.1:18420`)

### Memory, Receipts & Proofs
- `POST /v1/remember` — `{ shard, text, autoAnchor?, borgGroup?, level? }`
- `POST /v1/recall` — `{ shard?, query?, limit? }`
- `POST /v1/anchor` — `{ shard }`
- `POST /v1/tools/prove` — `{ shard, seq }` (returns full SPV `ProofBundle`)
- `POST /v1/tools/groundedAnswer` — `{ claims: [{ text, cites: [{ shard, seq }] }] }`
- `POST /v1/tools/forget` — `{ shard, seq }`
- `GET  /v1/verify/{token}` — public HTML/JSON verifier (`Accept: application/json`)

### Market, Trading & Discovery
- `POST /v1/tools/want` — `{ domains[], question, maxSats, targetShard? }`
- `POST /v1/tools/sell` — `{ shard, domains[], priceSats, description? }` (or `{ bountyId, ... }`)
- `POST /v1/tools/deals` — persisted deals, pending approvals, seller reputations, liquidity metrics
- `POST /v1/tools/peers` — signature-verified peers, handles, sell domains & Hub bounties
- `GET  /v1/topics/cluster?hint=<text>` — semantic topic & cluster suggestions
- `PATCH /v1/market/listings/{shard}` — `{ active: boolean }`
- `DELETE /v1/market/listings/{shard}` — remove listing
- `POST /v1/onboard/faucet` — request free testnet sats
- `POST /v1/onboard/policy-preset` — `{ profile?, preset: "buyer"|"seller"|"both", maxPerDeal?, maxPerDay?, zeroConfMax? }`
- `POST /v1/automation/kill` — `{ enabled: boolean }` (fail-closed market kill switch)
- `GET  /state` & `GET /events` — live dashboard state snapshot & typed SSE stream
- `GET  /v1/dock/detect` & `POST /v1/dock/apply` — auto-detect & 1-click dock local AI apps

### Public Spine Overlay Hub (`https://nektar.run/hub/*`)
- `GET  /hub/v1/health` — Hub status, topics, active bounties & fee advert
- `GET  /hub/v1/terms` — BRC-105 fee schedule & metered egress terms
- `GET  /hub/bounties` & `POST /hub/bounties/submit` — open knowledge bounties & verified submissions
- `POST /hub/submit` & `POST /hub/lookup` — BRC-22 / BRC-24 16-lane market orderbook (`ls_nektar`)
- `GET  /hub/events?cursor=<seq>` & `GET /hub/sync?cursor=<seq>` — real-time market SSE & catch-up sync
- `POST /hub/bbox/send` & `GET /hub/bbox/inbox` — NAT-safe counterparty trade relay
